head: codex/53-execution-proof-receipts
title: [C-SDLC v2] Make execution-proof receipts non-self-referential
body:
Closes #53

Adds a v3 execution-proof receipt contract that binds the exact substantive source commit and derives the evidence commit from the receipt's unique Git introduction, avoiding self-referential SHA rewrites. It verifies A-to-B-to-HEAD ancestry, confines A..B to issue evidence, rejects any later evidence-prefix touch including tamper-then-revert history, and validates source/test artifacts at A plus current receipt/log/artifact digests. Retained v2 receipts keep their exact-HEAD behavior.

Validation: focused repository-local A/B/C regression with product, test, source-digest, receipt, log, unrelated-ancestry, malformed-revision, and tamper-then-revert rejection; v2 compatibility; Ruby syntax; diff hygiene; typed issue validation and doctor. Exact-head subagent re-review approved c7b454b30beec5d537966765a24f33823535f562 with no P0-P3 findings.
